title: Retained Goldreich–Levin candidates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0<\tau\le 1$, let $E$ be a restricted Fourier weight estimate, and let $k<n$ be a natural number. Given a finite active family $\mathcal A$ of sets of coordinates, form the candidates at coordinate $k$ and retain precisely those sets $S$ for which $\tau^2/2<E(J,S\cap J)$, where $J=\{0,\ldots,k\}$ and $E(J,\cdot)$ denotes the estimate on subsets of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a restricted Fourier weight estimate
$\mathcal A$ is a finite family of sets of coordinates
